mapper.sql: c.credential_id credentialId,c.tenant_id tenantId,t.tenant_type tenantType,t.owner_ref_id clientId, t.tenant_name clientName,c.key_prefix keyPrefix,c.status storedStatus,t.owner_status tenantOwnerStatus, t.security_status tenantSecurityStatus,c.expires_time expiresTime,c.rotated_from_id rotatedFromId, c.version,c.create_time createTime,c.update_time updateTime
FROM t_api_credential c LEFT JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE c.credential_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF c

SELECT c.credential_id credentialId,c.tenant_id tenantId,t.tenant_type tenantType,t.owner_ref_id clientId, t.tenant_name clientName,c.key_prefix keyPrefix,c.status storedStatus,t.owner_status tenantOwnerStatus, t.security_status tenantSecurityStatus,c.expires_time expiresTime,c.version,c.create_time createTime,c.update_time updateTime
ORDER BY c.credential_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_credential SET status='REVOKED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','EXPIRED')
